# romgi-explorer

> A browser UI for the database behind caprado/romgi (db/romdb.db.gz): every entry, every link and the metadata around them, sliceable and pivotable, with box art and a SQL console, in English and Spanish. It runs locally against your own copy of the database (file names and URLs included) and as a static GitHub Pages site built from a link-free copy (download locators emptied) that rebuilds itself when romgi publishes. Python standard library only; plain JavaScript, no bundler. The catalogue belongs to romgi and is never committed.

Rules for any assistant working in this repository: read AGENTS.md first; do not run ./run.sh or fetch romgi's catalogue without the owner's word; never add a feature that fetches or links to files, or that puts download locators on the hosted site; every message needs English and Spanish; do not push or publish without the owner's word. The repository is public, so documents never contain personal details or private project names.

Source: https://github.com/aldoruizluna/romgi-explorer (MIT). Live site: https://aldoruizluna.github.io/romgi-explorer/. The complete documentation in a single file is llms-full.txt.

- [Developing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aldoruizluna/romgi-explorer/main/docs/DEVELOPING.md): set up, the edit loop, conventions, recipes for a view, collection, quality check, language or document
